title: Complaint Handling (Livechat): flow
start: Complaint opens
step: Acknowledge emotion
step: Read profile
check: Strong complaint, still upset? | yes: next | no: jump Validate + redirect, no credit
step: Compensation SOP (ATL approves)
end: Log outcome (QA)
Handle common Livechat complaint scenarios with empathy and strategy. Combine emotional acknowledgement with a strategic response.
Applies to losing-player and free-credit complaint scenarios on Livechat. Always acknowledge the emotion before moving to a solution.

x: Always acknowledge the emotion before moving to a solution or redirection.
Never promise a bonus you cannot deliver. If unsure, say "let me check", never a false commitment.
A credit is only ever given through the Compensation SOP: first-level handling first, last-week P&L ladder at SW x 40%, one per week, ATL approval.
For the formal compensation decision, use the Compensation SOP; for amounts and tier rules, the Bonus rules.

head: Complaint
What you see in profile
Recommended response
Strategy
rows: Losing a lot
Significant losses this week, SW has balance, no recent credits
"Saya nampak boss memang rugi sikit hari ni. Saya faham perasaan boss. Bagi saya check dulu ye."
Do first-level handling (luck, Jackpot, activities). If the player keeps asking and stays upset, follow the Compensation SOP. Never promise the credit before the ATL approves.
Losing little
Small losses, not enough for SW credit
Step 1 acknowledge: "Boss faham tu, memang kadang rasa macam tak kena." Step 2 game suggestion. Step 3 reframe toward hope.
Validate the feeling without committing a credit. Offer a fresh game. Reframe losses as timing, not bad luck.
Always asks for free credit
Habitual requests, no qualifying condition
Decline gently: "Boss hari ni belum ada free credit lagi ye." Redirect to a game. Promise future notification by SMS.
Redirect without rejection. The player should leave feeling looked after even without getting what they asked.

x: Malaysian events and holidays: chat about festivities, long weekends, public holidays.
Food and local culture: a universal opener. Ask about favourite dishes, hawker stalls, lunch.
Game discussions: games they enjoy, new titles, jackpot stories, recent wins.
Use complaint moments to listen and learn. Every complaint is data about the player's preferences and pain points.
No false commitment: if you cannot confirm a credit, say "let me check" first.
SW credit only when the scenario and remaining allowance permit.
Emotion first, solution second; skipping the acknowledgement loses the relationship.
For the formal compensation decision logic, refer to the Compensation SOP.
For Angpao / Free Credit / Reload amounts and tier rules, refer to the Bonus rules.
